name: PJM
context: Pennsylvania-New Jersey-Maryland (COMED zone) electricity market dataset with hourly zonal electricity price and exogenous load measurements spanning 6 years (2013-01-01 to 2018-12-24).

endo.name: price
endo.description: Day-ahead hourly zonal electricity price in the Commonwealth Edison (COMED) area of the PJM market (USD/MWh).

exo.name: system_load_forecast
exo.description: Forecasted total PJM system load in MW, reflecting anticipated electricity demand across the entire PJM interconnection.

exo.name: comed_load_forecast
exo.description: Forecasted zonal load in MW specific to the COMED area, capturing local demand conditions within the PJM market.
